policy: All 101 original nominees remain in scope. A source failure is not a missing horse. Public baseline records are acquisition evidence only until identity and career integrity are verified. Recent-form windows must never be substituted for full-career statistics.

raceHubFailureRecovery.note: Each former RaceHub failure now has replacement public/subscriber evidence in the verified career registry. Goodie Two Shoes remains deliberately quarantined from Flat career totals until Flat-only rows are separated. Mixed-code totals are not published as Melbourne Cup Flat career totals.

requirements: Identity/pedigree/connections cross-check for all baseline horses
Chronological full-career run integrity and duplicate/conflict audit
Distance/surface/going/course and class/stakes splits where publicly exposed
Carried weights and margins where publicly exposed
Official ratings kept distinct from Racing & Sports and Timeform ratings
Cup status and official weight evidence
Evidence URL/provenance for every promoted field
Quarantine same-name and contaminated evidence rather than infer

specialQuarantine.reason: Current evidence contains mixed Flat/jumps totals; Flat-only career split still required.
